name: ELIA Assistant
author: ELIA

sections.description:
ELIA Assistant is an AI chatbot that answers your customers 24/7 from your own FAQ, website and documents, and only from them. When a question needs a person, it hands the whole conversation over to your team.

This plugin adds the chat to your WordPress site. You need an ELIA Assistant account, which you can try free for 7 days, no credit card required.

The service

  • Answers only from the content you give it, not from the open internet.
  • Hands over questions it should not answer, with the full conversation.
  • One dashboard for all conversations, customers and insights.
  • The same knowledge base also answers on WhatsApp, Telegram and email.
  • Made in the EU, with a data processing agreement (DPA).

The plugin

  • Turn the chat on or off for the whole site without losing its settings.
  • Test mode for staging sites: their messages are marked as tests.
  • A floating chat button on every page, or an inline chat on the pages you choose.
  • The chat follows the language of each page (WPML, Polylang, TranslatePress, Weglot or the site language).
  • WooCommerce: one click creates a read-only key, so the assistant can answer questions about your products, prices and stock.
  • Look, avatar, CTA popup and display mode are set in the ELIA Assistant dashboard, without touching WordPress.

External Services

This plugin relies on the ELIA Assistant service, operated by ELIA, and loads the chat widget code from a public CDN. No data is sent anywhere until you enter your widget ID.

ELIA Assistant API (api.elia-assistant.com)
Used to fetch your saved widget configuration by its widget ID. The widget loader requests it in the visitor’s browser on pages that show the widget. The settings screen also requests it from your WordPress server each time it is opened, to preview the widget; only the widget ID is sent, no data about your site visitors.

ELIA Assistant widget loader (app.elia-assistant.com)
A small loader script that selects the current widget version. It is loaded in the visitor’s browser on every page that shows the widget, so the visitor’s IP address and browser details reach this host, as with any web request.

ELIA Assistant chat service (eliainfra.app.n8n.cloud)
When a visitor uses the chat, the messages they type, and any contact details they choose to enter in the conversation, are sent from their browser to the ELIA Assistant chat service at eliainfra.app.n8n.cloud. This service is run by ELIA on n8n Cloud, operated by n8n GmbH. ELIA processes the messages, including with AI models, to generate replies, and stores the conversations so you can review them in the ELIA Assistant dashboard.

Terms and conditions: https://elia-assistant.com/terms-and-conditions
Privacy policy: https://elia-assistant.com/privacy-policy
n8n terms: https://n8n.io/legal/self-serve-terms/
n8n data processing agreement: https://n8n.io/legal/data-processing-agreement/

jsDelivr CDN (cdn.jsdelivr.net)
The loader fetches the chat widget JavaScript bundle (the open-source @elia-assistant/chatui package) from jsDelivr. This request is made in the visitor’s browser on pages that show the widget.
Terms of use: https://www.jsdelivr.com/terms/terms-of-use
Privacy policy: https://www.jsdelivr.com/terms/privacy-policy
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate the plugin from Plugins > Add New (search for “ELIA Assistant”).
  2. In the ELIA Assistant dashboard, open Configuration > Integrations and copy the widget ID from the WordPress card.
  3. In WordPress, open Settings > ELIA Assistant, paste the widget ID and follow the steps on the screen.
  4. Choose where the chat appears and its language, then click Save changes. The chat appears on your site right away.

With “Only on pages I choose”, the settings screen gives you a shortcode for a Shortcode block on those pages:

[elia_assistant]

The optional height attribute sets the chat height, for example [elia_assistant height="400px"] (default 500px).
sections.faq:
Do I need an ELIA Assistant account? How much does it cost?

Yes. The plugin only displays the chat on your site; the answers come from the ELIA Assistant service, which is paid. You can try it free for 7 days, no credit card required. Plans are based on the number of messages, with monthly or annual billing. Create your account at https://elia-assistant.com

Where do I get my widget ID?

In the ELIA Assistant dashboard, open Configuration > Integrations and the WordPress card under Channels. The widget ID is not a secret: it is in the embed code of every site that shows the chat.

The chat is not showing up.

Check that the widget settings are saved in the ELIA Assistant dashboard and that the widget ID is complete. If the settings screen says the widget was not found, copy the widget ID again, or open Customize Chat Widget in the dashboard and click Save.

Does the chat follow the language of each page on a multilingual site?

Yes, with Same as the page selected. The plugin asks WPML, Polylang or Weglot which language the page is in, and otherwise uses the WordPress language of the page, which TranslatePress and most other language plugins set. With another setup, a developer can name the language with the elia_assistant_language filter, which receives and returns a two-letter code:

add_filter( 'elia_assistant_language', function ( $lang ) { return 'de'; } );

Translators that work only in the visitor’s browser, such as Google Translate widgets, are not detected. The assistant’s name and welcome message for each language are set in the ELIA Assistant dashboard.

Is my WooCommerce API key sent to ELIA Assistant?

Not by the plugin. The plugin creates the key in your own store and shows it once on the settings screen, so you can copy it and enter it in the ELIA Assistant dashboard yourself. The plugin never transmits it. The key and secret are kept for at most two minutes so the settings screen can show them; after that the plugin keeps only the key ID and the last few characters, so it can show the status and delete the key later. The key is created with Read permission only. You can delete it at any time from the settings screen, or from WooCommerce > Settings > Advanced > REST API.

What happens to my data when I delete the plugin?

When you delete the plugin from the Plugins screen, it asks whether to keep its settings. If you remove them, the plugin also deletes the WooCommerce key it generated. If you keep them, they are used again when you reinstall the plugin. Deleting several plugins at once removes the settings. Conversations already stored in ELIA Assistant stay in your ELIA Assistant account.
sections.changelog:
1.0.0

  • First release in the WordPress.org plugin directory.
  • New settings screen: step-by-step setup, a preview of your chat, plain choices for where the chat appears and its language, and a shortcode generator. Developer options are tucked away.
  • The plugin is connected with the widget ID from the WordPress card in the ELIA Assistant dashboard instead of an API key.
  • Settings link on the Plugins screen, and a dismissible reminder to enter your widget ID after activation.
  • Text domain changed to elia-assistant to match the WordPress.org plugin slug.
  • The Advanced settings field now accepts only a valid JSON object.
  • The shortcode height attribute now accepts only CSS lengths (px, em, rem, vh, %).
  • When you delete the plugin, a dialog asks whether to keep its settings or remove them together with the generated WooCommerce key.
  • Admin script moved to the standard WordPress script queue.
  • Documentation of external services updated.
  • Czech translation added.

Earlier versions

  • Distributed manually, outside the WordPress.org plugin directory. They added the WooCommerce read-only key, translations and the dashboard wording.

Clear settings right in WordPress, and a simple WooCommerce connection so the assistant can answer questions about your products.
Insights in the ELIA Assistant dashboard: messages by intent, channel, sentiment and over time.
Chat widget configuration in the ELIA Assistant dashboard: behavior, CTA popup, theme, avatar and display mode.
All incoming messages with their channel, intent, sentiment and language.
